goal: Allow external mining software to submit and prefer a block atomically over IPC without race conditions
Avoid requiring a separate RPC call to prefer a competing block with identical work
reviewability: Needs rebase and author response to an open objection
Review would repeat questions already asked until the author replies
agreement: Concept approval for atomically submitting and preferring same-work blocks (pablomartin4btc, Sjors)
Unaddressed objection: inconsistent duplicate handling if precious changes return status, no author reply (Sjors)
Rational for miners to prefer their own blocks for relay, despite game-theoretic caveats (Sjors)

categories.name: mining
why: P3 because interface completeness benefits external miners preferring same-work blocks, but is deferrable
Impact is limited to external mining setups handling simultaneous competing blocks of equal work
